summary_en: Two new letters, asking someone if they are hungry or thirsty, and answering.
notes: CURRICULUM_PATH lesson 9 (lessons 9 and 10 may swap: path note). Units C25 ຫ (h, initial role only; the silent ຫ before ນ ມ ລ is a later unit) and C05 ຈ. Core words W000072 hungry, W000005 you (ຫິວເຂົ້າ and ຫິວນ້ຳ are taught as ຫິວ + ເຂົ້າ / ນ້ຳ). Bonus W000082 five, W000629 plate. Sentences: S000002886 He is hungry, S000002887 Are you hungry? with reply S000002888 Not hungry, S000001170 Are you thirsty? (existing, resegmented ຫິວ + ນ້ຳ) with reply S000002889 Yes, I'm thirsty, S000000007 How are you? (existing). Composed sentences unverified. Recycles W000031, W000019, W000003, W000011, W000001. ເຈົ້າ tagged person|function (never a wrong option: polite yes particle).
